source: Dark Ages: Werewolf (White Wolf, 2003), chapter four
note: Short summaries with page references. Read the book for each Gift's full description. Entries marked chk are partly read from a damaged scan; check the page before relying on them.

gifts.e: Works a mechanism from afar (a crossbow, a bolt, a winch).
Hides weakness from reading; guards against Soulsight. A roll per encounter.
Speaks with animals; a roll per encounter and kind of animal.
Each success adds one to the difficulty of Perception rolls to notice them.
By touch, an extra die on the recipient's Mental rolls (difficulty 5 on Garou, 6 others).
A howl heard far by successes, stirring those who hear it.
Makes inedible things into food; difficulty by the ingredients.
Creates about a cubic foot of an element per success within 60 feet.
Everyone but allies who hear them gawks where the Garou points, a round per success.
A laid hand keeps mother and unborn child well for a week.
−1 difficulty on Archery and sight-based Perception.
A floating light for a minute per success; moves at 10 yards a turn.
A touch knocks the target down; it does no damage itself.
After a turn's study, an extra damage die against the target; more successes reveal more.
Keeps food fresh a month per success (it tastes salty).
Reflexive; leaping distance doubles.
Perfect sense of direction and distance under a night sky.
Perception difficulties −2 in Homid or Glabro, −3 in the wolf forms.
Sends a silent message to the pack; more successes, more complex.
Allies who see them get an automatic success on Willpower rolls (not the Ahroun themself).
Glows with moonlight (100 feet): +1 to hand-to-hand attacks against them, −1 to missiles.
Senses a caern nearby; 3 successes give distance and direction, 5 the way.
Appears as a man; light touch doesn't break it; ends on shifting.
Fire damage counts as bashing instead of aggravated.
Each success heals a health level; can even remove Battle Scars.
Social difficulties drop by one.
Mimics an animal or human cry to lure prey; difficulty by the sound.
After a turn of sharpening, claws do an extra die of damage.
No wound penalties for the rest of the scene.
Three extra Stamina dice against supernatural poisons.
Always on: tracking them by scent is at +2 difficulty.
A sweet, clinging scent and lacquer marks a target for an hour per success.
Smells Kinfolk and Garou at once; one success for a human or animal, more for other beings.
Ties in opposed rolls go to them, facedowns included.
Senses Wyrm taint nearby; vampires always register, the older the stronger.
Sheds fur and skin to slip grapples and bonds (−2 difficulty on such rolls).
Wild animals within 20 feet lose a die; tame animals treat the Garou as master.
Runs on ice and snow as on solid ground, leaving no tracks.
Running speed doubles; no extra actions.
Understands and speaks the language of spirits.
Tells which spoken words are true and which false.
Foes flinch (−1 initiative); allies are awed.
Draws minds into a shared dream; a roll only for the unwilling.
Eye contact fills a human with dread of the wild.
Reduces a target to animal wits for a turn per success.
Searchers must beat their successes on Perception + Alertness to spot them while they keep still.
Resisted by the creature's Willpower; a Wyrm creature that loses must come.
Summons a spirit known by name to a task; or 2 Gnosis calls every Gaian spirit within a mile.
Everyone within 10 feet must get a Willpower success (8) or be stunned a turn.
Gives a spirit a command; a botch makes it hostile.
Each success adds a Brawl die; the Garou enters berserk frenzy.
A fog rises (4 near water, 6 temperate, 9 desert); others in it lose half their dice for sight.
The foe loses two Willpower (more in the book).
Each success takes a die from the target's next turn.
Learns a group's feelings and expectations; more successes, more detail.
As Mother's Touch, but the Garou may heal themself.
After a turn's focus, halves a fleeing target's speed.
Hearers roll Willpower (8, allies 6) or flee in terror.
After a turn's focus, each success adds one to Stamina for soak (silver included).
Animals treat them as an ordinary human; the Curse on humans stays.
Runs at full speed 72 hours without rest; then collapses as long. +1 Gnosis to share it.
Appears to carry a dread disease of their choosing.
Follows a target by scent alone; a roll only when the scent could be lost.
Reveals hidden guilt; five successes give specifics.
Detects silver within 15 feet; three successes pinpoint it.
Always knows the way to a chosen quarry; a roll only if it hides.
Senses supernatural presences; more successes, more detail.
Receives visions of omens; the roll helps make sense of them.
Speaks any human language met, with an accent; no literacy.
+10 to initiative always; a Gnosis point adds 10 more.
One target flees a turn per success (5+: the scene); Garou freeze instead. Willpower resists a turn.
Once per scene, every two successes restore a Willpower point.
A dedicated handheld item appears in their grip at the end of the turn.
Cows the target a turn per success: it can't attack but may defend.
A brew, potent for a day, that drives the drinker into a strengthened berserk frenzy.
Each success rusts away one iron object; difficulty by the amount of metal.
By touch, ends a frenzying Garou's frenzy.
Beat the target's Perception + Subterfuge: the next successful attack's damage dice double.
The target stands in mute awe until attacked.
Invokes the full Delirium in any form; a group uses its highest Willpower.
Reflexive; each success is an automatic success to strike. Once per turn.
After three turns of concentration, drives a spirit out of a body or place.
Lures a victim to the Garou's side; three successes are needed.
Sees in pitch darkness; no darkness penalties.
Faeries answer; Gnosis sets their power, successes their number.
Each success cleanses a barrel of water or a trencher of food, or heals a level.
Each success dodges one missile automatically; not hand-to-hand.
Lends a packmate or Bone Gnawer Rage, Willpower, health levels or a Gift they know.
For three turns, 30 extra feet of jump per success.
Every two successes add one to their frenzy difficulties; afterwards a Willpower point or a frenzy check.
Speaks mind to mind with someone known or with a token of theirs, at any distance.
Strength doubles for a turn per success, at a cost afterwards.
Learns a spirit's type, name and traits by successes.
Opens a bridge to a caern linked by a pathstone, within 1,000 miles.
Sees into the Umbra; automatic if Gnosis is at least the Gauntlet.
A touch curses the target; successes set how long.
The target suffers the Fenrir's own wound penalties.
Reshapes a dead natural material into a useful item; difficulty by complexity.
Makes a lie believed; more successes convince more listeners.
Spits in a foe's shadow and may then wound them by striking it.
Claws turn to silver: aggravated damage most Fera can't soak; the Garou gains a Rage point each turn and non-combat difficulties rise by two.
Domestic animals turn feral; successes set the area.
The target rages (or frenzies) for a turn per success.
Each success adds a die to dealings with spirits nearby (not Banes).
A spirit that saw an event retells it; Gaian spirits can't refuse.
Fluent and literate in any human language met; successes set fluency.
Confuses paths in a two-mile radius per success; other Garou may resist.
After a turn of watching a fighter, each success is a bonus die against them.
Paints woad figures on their body (one per success) that spring to life in a fight.
Wyrm-tainted who see them roll Willpower or Courage (7) or flee.
Witnesses react on the Delirium chart in reverse: awe instead of fear.
Asks a town's spirits what passes there; a botch, they lie.
Foes meeting their gaze roll Willpower (8) against their successes or suffer.
Speaks with all animals and draws those within 10 miles per success; they heed requests.
A controlled frenzy for two rounds per success, ended at will.
Vanishes and reappears within 20 yards per success, out of sight.
Stuns the target a round per success and takes a die per success from its pools.
Arrows fly instantly to any target in sight and can't be dodged.
Seems a normal human to every sense and power; Rage counts as lower by the successes; no Rage or shifting meanwhile.
Claws snap off as glass shards in the wound, adding aggravated damage.
Blocks a blood-pool being's use of blood powers.
An all-turn attack; on a hit, two extra damage dice and a lasting wound.
Takes another's face, voice and manner for a day per success.
Anyone working against them or their pack glows, even if hidden by powers.
Quills deal Strength +1 aggravated to anyone grappled or striking bare-handed.
Gnaws through wood (3), iron (6) or steel (9); the bite gains two dice for the scene.
Can hold three points above the maximum in one chosen trait (Gnosis, Rage or Willpower).
Carries held items or beings across the Gauntlet; Willpower by size.
A carved rune keeps iron weapons from wounding them.
Afflicts the target with a wasting disease; it resists with Gnosis or Stamina.
Mind control and mental attacks against them are at difficulty 10.
Silver strikes roll three extra botch-only dice; silver wounds soak and heal as bashing or lethal. Only while the moon is visible.
Turns 10 feet of ground per success to muck: movement halved for all but the Garou.
Extended Willpower contest; foes beaten by three successes submit.
Senses a far place they know as if present.
An illusion of 10 cubic feet per Gnosis point; doubters must beat the successes.
Draws listeners into acting out a tale; only the unwilling cost Gnosis and a roll.
Once per scene, evades an attack that would take them below Crippled.
An improvised song that bares a subject's secrets, one per success.
Travels at great speed; no extra actions.
Spirits within 100 feet lose a die per success.
Drains a spirit's Essence (resisted Gnosis); every two points drained restore the Garou.
Innate: regains a Rage point in any turn they take damage, without a frenzy check from it.
Steals a Rage point per turn for a turn per success; once per target per scene.
A touched limb withers: unusable, +2 to Dexterity difficulties, half speed for a leg.
Passes as a member of another culture; difficulty by how alien it is.
Each success is five aggravated fire levels to all within 30 feet.
A howl heard 20 miles per success; Garou who join the hunt gain three Willpower (max 10).
Takes the shape of any normal animal; more successes allow stranger shapes.
Controls a single fire; successes set the radius, from arm's reach to a city.
Extended roll: shapes a dream creature with a dot of traits per success.
Elementals shake the earth for 25 yards; others must keep their feet (Dexterity + Athletics).
An elemental grants control of about a 20-foot cube of air, earth, fire or water.
For a turn per success, human works and tools can't touch the Garou unless they wish it.
Becomes ghostly mist a turn per success.
Gaia answers a plea to cleanse the land as she sees fit.
Travels 100 miles per Gnosis point to a place they have seen.
With eye contact, turns the victim to stone for a round per success.
Binds a target to a task until it is done.
Grows or shrinks for an hour per success, gaining or losing traits.
Two extra dice of hand-to-hand damage, aggravated even in Homid or Glabro.
Great Wolves come, one per point of Rage and Gnosis spent.
Natural fire can't harm them; supernatural fire does a quarter, as bashing; flaming blows add two aggravated dice.
After a turn's focus, immune to silver, and their blows wound Garou as silver.
Inflicts a derangement (DA:V pp. 261–263) for a day per success.
Reshapes a spirit's traits or nature (resisted Gnosis); difficulty by the change.
Swallows a being or object whole; the target dodges with Dexterity + Dodge.
Destroys Intelligence, one dot per two Gnosis spent.
Those nearby who fail to beat their successes on Willpower (8) obey: 1 mild, 3 most, 5 nearly anything.
Each success strips all of a target's powers for a turn.
Steps sideways at will without a roll; −2 to enter or leave Umbral realms.
One shadow double per Gnosis spent: same traits, no Gifts, one health level.
Turns a human into a wolf (one net success on a resisted roll).
Calls one of the Great Beasts; extra successes make it more willing.
Each success gives allies within 100 feet (packmates within 100 miles) a Willpower point.
Animates one tree per success.
Every three successes steal one use of a foe's power.
Calls on the totem for aid; more successes, a greater intervention.
Summons Wyldlings who change the situation in their favor.
